title: Is anyone else haunted by their dreams after waking?
content: I dream about the mall world, the transit hub, the bathroom, the hotel, and other recurring places all the time - the vast majority of my dreams go back to all these same locations. The plot lines are always a little different and I have varying levels of lucidity in these dreams (I don’t lucid dream nearly as often anymore as I did when I was younger). However, I often wake up feeling like part of me is still ‘stuck’ there, as if I’m being haunted by the dream for the rest of the day. I’ll have emotional or visual flashbacks to the dream while awake and going about my business, and this gets especially strong when I climb back into bed again, sort of like how you might associate a particular memory with a specific place. More than once as a kid, I’d wake up and almost forget that what I experienced was a dream and not reality (eg. I once dreamt in like, grade 5 that Lindsay Lohan was my older sister; it felt so real that I didn’t even question it, like, “oh yeah, of course Lindsay Lohan is my sister” until lunchtime). Everyone I’ve ever mentioned this to thinks it’s super unusual and I can’t say I’ve met anyone who’s experienced the same thing. Is anyone here haunted by previous nights’ dreams?
